items.lede: The bloc wants to curb Big Tech’s grip on children with its new EU Kids Act, but age checks, parental oversight, and privacy concerns could make its plan difficult to implement.
items.title: The EU Plans to Ban Social Media For Under-13s

items.lede: It's the most sweeping proposal yet to limit kids' access to social media.
items.title: Europe's EU Kids Act would ban social media access for children under 13
